test_cases.name: iteration-ssot-no-max
test_cases.description: S11 — Iteration Ownership SSOT (S2): Resume Phase 5 phai doc current_iteration tu fix-status.json.phases.phase_5.loop_state.current_iteration only, KHONG dung MAX(checkpoint, fix-status). Backward compat: legacy checkpoint co verify_loop_state.current_iteration → IGNORE.

precondition.context: Legacy field current_iteration=1 trong checkpoint, fix-status SSOT current_iteration=3. PRE-S2 logic dung MAX → 3, S2 logic dung SSOT → 3. Test verify SSOT logic se ALWAYS chon fix-status, KE CA khi legacy field nho hon.

expected_behavior: Resume Logic (S2): KHONG goi MAX(), chi doc fix-status SSOT
Backward compat: legacy verify_loop_state.current_iteration=1 → IGNORE (warn log)
KHONG restart Phase 3, KHONG reset fix-log.json
Tiep tuc VERIFY_FIX → VERIFY_DOCS → ... → VERIFY_EVALUATE iteration 3
Edge case: legacy field LON HON SSOT (=5 vs SSOT=3) → VAN CHON SSOT=3 (NO MAX)
NOT_expected: Goi MAX(legacy_iter, ssot_iter) — DA BO o S2
Crash khi legacy field thieu (graceful: chi dung SSOT)
assertions: Edge: legacy=5, SSOT=3 → resume tai iteration=3 (NOT 5)
Acceptance: S2 SSOT verified — F2 covered

test_cases.name: phase-4-docs-crossref-fail
test_cases.description: S11 — Phase 4a docs-sync hook (S8): wf-fix-execute claim cap nhat .mc-data/docs/phase2-features/[sys]/[mod]/[feat].md nhung git diff KHONG co changes → wf-fix-docs-crossref.sh detect mismatch + status=warning (soft warn, exit 0). KHONG block POST-GATE.

precondition.context: Claim 2 docs updated, git diff chi 1 → mismatch CUST-002.md (claimed nhung khong co diff). Soft warn: bao user nhung KHONG block.

expected_behavior: Phase 4a hook: chay wf-fix-docs-crossref.sh sau khi claim docs updated
Script doc fix-log.json + git diff --name-only HEAD
(a) Claimed in fix-log nhung KHONG in git diff → mismatch type='missing_git_diff'
(b) In git diff nhung KHONG claim → mismatch type='untracked_modification'
Exit code 0 (soft warn, KHONG block POST-GATE)
WARN log: 'Docs sync mismatch detected: 1 file(s) claimed but not in git diff'
assertions: Edge: git unavailable → graceful skip, status='skipped' + exit 0
Acceptance: S8 docs-sync soft warn verified — G3 covered
